cover_headline: Royal Enfield Posts Record Festive Sales of 2.67 Lakh Motorcycles
facts: Royal Enfield sold 1,33,442 motorcycles in October 2026, up 7 per cent from 1,24,951 a year earlier
Festive sales across September and October reached 2,67,400 units, surpassing last year's entire festive-season total before this season had closed
Exports jumped 47 per cent to 11,915 units in October, while domestic sales rose 4 per cent to 1,21,527 units

quote.text: It has been an exceptional festive season for us at Royal Enfield. Riders across the country continue to choose our brand and motorcycles, making this our best-ever festive performance.
quote.speaker: B. Govindarajan
quote.role: Managing Director of Eicher Motors and CEO of Royal Enfield

end.headline: Royal Enfield Posts Record Festive Sales of 2.67 Lakh Motorcycles
end.line: October sales rose 7 per cent to 1,33,442 units as exports jumped 47 per cent, taking September-October festive sales to a company-high 2,67,400 units.
